assessment.nobel_worthiness: The opening of high-energy neutrino astronomy is a fundamental new observational window on the violent Universe.
assessment.attribution: Halzen provided decisive scientific leadership and Karle was central to the detector effort; both fit the proposed achievement.
assessment.maturity: IceCube established an astrophysical flux and has made the method credible as a lasting branch of astronomy.
uncertainties: The underlying experimental achievement relied on a very large collaboration, making individual credit inevitably selective.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Black-hole imaging is an exceptional instrumental and observational achievement that made a once inaccessible regime measurable.
assessment.attribution: Falcke, Moran, and Doeleman represent key conceptual, interferometric, and project leadership contributions.
assessment.maturity: Images of more than one black-hole system and extensive calibration work make the result robust.
uncertainties: The collaboration is unusually broad, so any three-person attribution will omit major contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have transformed precision timekeeping and create unusually sensitive probes of fundamental physics.
assessment.attribution: Katori's lattice-clock concept and Ye's decisive experimental development form a clear and balanced attribution.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories have achieved extraordinary accuracy and reproducibility over many years.
uncertainties: The ultimate replacement of present time standards remains a technical and institutional process.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: X-ray free-electron lasers created a powerful new measurement capability for matter on atomic length and ultrafast time scales.
assessment.attribution: Pellegrini, Rossbach, and Kim cover the central accelerator, facility, and theoretical foundations.
assessment.maturity: Operational facilities and a wide body of science demonstrate that this is a durable experimental platform.
uncertainties: The achievement has many precursor and facility contributors, complicating a strict three-person division of credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP supplied a remarkably precise empirical foundation for modern cosmological parameters and early-Universe physics.
assessment.attribution: Bennett, Spergel, and Page represent the mission leadership, interpretation, and experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: Its findings have been tested against subsequent precision cosmology measurements and remain foundational.
uncertainties: The scientific legacy overlaps with earlier and later cosmic-microwave-background missions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum key distribution established a physically new approach to secure communication and stimulated a major experimental field.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Brassard established essential protocols, while Pan led influential realization and network-scale experiments.
assessment.maturity: The field has progressed from foundational demonstrations to demanding long-distance and network experiments.
uncertainties: Ekert's independent foundational contribution makes limiting recognition to three people difficult.
Practical security depends on implementation details beyond the ideal protocols.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Neodymium-iron-boron magnets are a materials breakthrough with profound and enduring technological consequences.
assessment.attribution: Sagawa and Croat are the leading credited independent developers of the high-performance magnet material.
assessment.maturity: Its broad, decades-long adoption establishes both reproducibility and extraordinary practical importance.
uncertainties: The advance may be judged more as a major technological materials development than a Nobel-scale physics discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic crystals introduced a compelling way to control light through engineered band structures and enabled a broad field.
assessment.attribution: Yablonovitch and John made seminal conceptual contributions, with Joannopoulos central to the theoretical framework.
assessment.maturity: The ideas have been extensively tested and incorporated into many photonic devices and measurement approaches.
uncertainties: Applications are diverse, but no single experimental consequence has the singular character of the highest-ranked discoveries.
